// diagnostic

E1249

`{value}` is not a valid toolchain pin.

What

`{value}` is not a valid toolchain pin.

Why

The `jet:` field pins which Jet toolchain builds this project (D-JPK-TOOLCHAIN1); its value is a channel ref, not a version range. `>=1.0.0`-style constraints don't name one reproducible toolchain.

Fix

Write a channel: `jet: 0.4` (track the 0.4 series), `jet: 0.4.2` (exact), or a named channel like `jet: main`.
